notes.title: New Enemy Update!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=U50BfZvqWfc;full][/previewyoutube]MAJOR UPDATE: New enemy types have been added for all maps! Grab your friends and team up against The Mutant and The Ice Mutant enemy types, each with brand new movesets and abilities.

Defenders is back with another BIG update and this time we are adding some super fun, super aggressive new enemy types. These mutant enemy types have a variety of different attacks that will be sure to add some more challenge to the game!

Additionally, the option to invert X and Y axes have been added to the settings!

notes.title: Halloween Update + New Map + New Towers!
notes.notes:
MAJOR DEFENDERS UPDATE: Introducing THREE NEW TOWERS: SPIKE TRAP, ICE OBELISK, TESLA COIL each with unique powers and strategies. Get even more creative with defensive strategies with these new towers that are sure to change up the game big time.

Unlock the NEW MAP "Forest" out now which is a spooky redwood forest with dense fog. Take to the trees and pick off enemies from above on tree bridges, but be careful because enemies can do the same.

HALLOWEEN ACCESSORIES have been added! Show off to your friends with a new skull mask, witch hat, and jack-o-lantern head.

notes.title: Customization Update + New Map!
notes.notes:
MAJOR DEFENDERS UPDATE: CUSTOMIZE your own character now with 20 new colors and accessories to stand out amongst your friends! You are now able to choose a base player color and choose from a male or female model! Also enjoy 8 different customizable accessories that you can put on your player like a tophat or fedora! 

Unlock the NEW MAP "Tundra" out now which is a one-lane canyon map that tunnels enemies towards the Core. Place towers on high bluffs and climb up to an abandoned arctic base to pick enemies off! 

ENEMY SURGES have been added! Some waves will now have an enemy surge where one type of enemy will be the only type that spawns that round. Always be prepared for a surge!

PATCH NOTES:

 Player customization has been added!
 A new map called the Tundra was added.
 The volume of the player’s footsteps and jumping sounds were decreased.
 Enemy footstep volume has been decreased.
 The shooting range of all towers were increased.
 Core Tank Enemy added.
 Enemy surges were added! On some waves, only enemies of a single class spawn. 
 FAL damage increased!
 Decreased countdown beep volume.
 Fixed screen scaling for Ultrawide resolutions
